summary: Get Permissions and Feature Flags for Specification Sections
description: This endpoint returns permissions and feature flags for the specification sections tool.

canUseDocumentsTool.description: Whether user can use documents tool

canSeeDocusign.description: Whether user can see DocuSign integration

canShowUploads.description: Whether user can show specification uploads

canDeletePendingSpecificationUploads.description: Whether user can delete pending specification uploads

canReviewSpecifications.description: Whether user can review uploaded specifications

canOpenCurrentSpecBook.description: Whether user can open current spec book

canForwardViaEmail.description: Whether user can forward via email

canViewSubmittalDraftRequests.description: Whether user can view submittal draft requests

canManuallyCreateDivisions.description: Whether user can manually create divisions

canCreateSpecificationSets.description: Whether user can create specification sets

canManuallyCreateSpecSections.description: Whether user can manually create specification sections

canConfigureSpecifications.description: Whether user can access the Specifications configuration page

canViewDownloadLog.description: Whether user can view specification revision download logs

canViewDeletedSpecifications.description: Whether user can view deleted specifications

canEditRelatedItem.description: Whether user can edit related items

canViewChangeHistory.description: Whether user can view specification change history

submittalsFromSpecsMfeEnabled.description: Whether submittals from specs MFE is enabled

customFieldsSpecificationSectionRevision.description: Whether custom fields for specification section revision is enabled

specificationsBulkDownloadModalEnabled.description: Whether bulk download modal is enabled

specificationsMfeEnabled.description: Whether the Specifications MFE is enabled

specificationsSettingsMfeEnabled.description: Whether the Specifications settings MFE is enabled

specificationsLandingMfeEnabled.description: Whether the Specifications landing MFE is enabled

specificationsAllRevisionsMfeEnabled.description: Whether the Specifications all revisions MFE is enabled

specificationsRecycleBinMfeEnabled.description: Whether the Specifications recycle bin MFE is enabled

specificationsAreaMfeEnabled.description: Whether the Specifications area MFE is enabled

specificationsMfeInfoPageEnabled.description: Whether the Specifications info page MFE is enabled

specificationsAreaTransferRedirectEnable.description: Whether specification area transfer redirects are enabled

specExpAdvancedOpts.description: Whether the experimental Upload Specification advanced options (e.g., Project Title field) are enabled. Sourced from the LaunchDarkly flag `spec_exp_advanced_opts`.

403.description: User does not have right permissions
